crossRefs.note: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over…
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…

translations.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
translations.bsb: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
translations.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
translations.asv: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
